answeredQuestions.bg-011-owner-delegated-review-2026-10-04: Owner confirmed the 20% lower assessment-to-ready-to-install elapsed-time and 25% fewer net coordination-hours values as proposed. answeredQuestions.owner-pilot-contract-scope-2026-10-04: Owner clarified that every current contract/framework is required to participate in live pilot delivery. This is an owner-directed scope condition only; no contract is presumed to permit participation, and supplier activity is blocked until Procurement/Legal confirm agreement authority, required data/measurement terms and capacity/readiness. If a contract fails a gate, live pilot approval is blocked until resolved; no control is waived.
answeredQuestions.missed-appointment-threshold-clarificati: Owner confirmed the missed-appointment control is configurable with provisional default 5; preserve strict greater-than so the sixth eligible event triggers human review; count only a confirmed appointment with verified resident no-access; record provider/contractor no-shows, cancellations and reschedules separately; count only while the same case is active and reset the counter only when a human closes the case. Public evidence does not validate five. Executive Reviewer, Asset Executive, Resident Engagement and Retrofit Programme Manager role-profile reviews support human investigation only and identify company records, Housing/Repairs ratification, Resident Engagement review, named handoff and configuration/change governance as open. These are drafting directions and simulated perspectives, not company policy approval, resident evidence or live-use authorization.
answeredQuestions.workflow-portfolio-and-business-value-20: Owner asks how to cover the other workflows from Case Study 48 and the role-agent analysis, including where the business value lies. BRD v0.14.1 maps stock prioritisation, assessment/design readiness, resident service and access, supplier capacity and procurement, hazard response, quality/defects, invoice/payment and grant reconciliation, programme orchestration, and portfolio investment to problem hypotheses, human decision owners, bounded AI assistance, and proposed business-value measures. End-to-end comparison and task-level agent comparison remain distinct; proposed targets are not validated forecasts.
answeredQuestions.capstone-case-presentation-framing-2026-: Owner directs the capstone to present Proper North Homes as the real customer case and attendees as its stakeholders in their actual roles. The records constructed for the exercise do not establish actual company performance, resident outcomes, systems or operating decisions. Role-profile agents remain research instruments, not the attendees or evidence of stakeholder agreement.
